filtersOrSort: Client-side only: filter pills 'All' | 'Content' | 'Guides' | 'Products' (FILTERS array, id: SavedItemKind | 'all') filter the already-fetched `items` array in memory via items.filter(i => i.kind === filter) — no filter/sort param is ever sent to getSavedItems(); the call takes no arguments.
'All' pill label shows a live count (`All ${items.length}`) once items have loaded, otherwise the static label 'All'.
reads.pagination: None observed. getSavedItems() takes no page/cursor argument and returns the full SavedItem[] in one call; no infinite scroll, load-more button, or page control renders on this screen.

authContext.note: No explicit gate check (no creatorGates() call, no role branch) appears in src/app/(app)/saved/page.tsx itself — the screen assumes a logged-in user only implicitly, via living under the (app) route group and returning a per-user saved list. No stub or session check within this screen's own scope proves the gate is enforced here; it is presumably enforced by the (app) layout/SessionGate wrapper, which is outside this screen's scan-map file list and was not read.

special.note: No polling/interval, no file upload or download affordance anywhere in this screen's code. Data is fetched once on mount (useEffect(load, [load])) and again only if the user presses the ErrorState's retry action.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: items === null — true on initial mount before getSavedItems() resolves, and again briefly on every load() re-invocation (retry) since load() resets items to null before refetching. Renders GridSkeleton (4 placeholder cards).
getSavedItems() promise rejects; catch sets error to e.message (or a fallback string) and renders ErrorState with an onRetry that calls load() again.
uiStatesHandled.reachabilityNote: getMockSavedItems() (src/lib/api/mocks/settings.ts) unconditionally awaits a delay and returns MOCK_SAVED_ITEMS — there is no code path in the mock that ever throws or rejects, and settings.ts's getSavedItems() calls it directly with no try/fetch fallback (pure mock delegation, not the try-fetch-then-mock pattern). So in the current mock-driven app this state can never actually be entered by any user action; it only becomes reachable once a real backend replaces the mock and can return a network/5xx failure.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: items resolved successfully and items.length === 0. Renders EmptyState icon='Bookmark', title='Nothing saved yet', caption='Bookmark courses, guides and products and they'll line up here.', action='Explore content' -> router.push('/').
uiStatesHandled.reachabilityNote: MOCK_SAVED_ITEMS is a module-level constant built from the fixed SAVED_AT_BY_ID map (10 entries), each resolved via mockContentById against the fixed mock content catalog; all 10 ids currently resolve successfully, so items.length is always 10 at runtime today. This state has no live trigger under the current mock data — it would only become reachable if a real backend returns a user with zero saved items, or if the mock data were edited to remove entries.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: items.length > 0 but the currently selected filter pill (content/guide/product) matches zero items in items.filter(i => i.kind === filter). Renders EmptyState icon='Bookmark', title='Nothing here yet', caption='Try another filter, or browse everything you've saved.', action='Show all' -> setFilter('all').
uiStatesHandled.reachabilityNote: Checked the current mock content catalog against kindForContentType's mapping for the 10 fixed SAVED_AT_BY_ID ids: 7 map to 'content' (course/video/audio types), 1 to 'guide' (pdf), 2 to 'product' (template/image). Every one of the three named filter pills therefore has at least one match under today's fixed mock data, so this branch of the empty-state ternary is currently unreachable by any filter selection — it only becomes reachable once saved-item kinds vary per real user (e.g. a user who has saved zero guides).

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: items resolved with length > 0 and the filtered array (by current pill) also has length > 0 — the default 'all' state on first successful load. Renders a 2-column grid of ContentCard per filtered SavedItem, keyed by item.id, passed item.content.
